name: Shizuku
source:
A woman of the Fuchsia who became the guardian of the orphaned [url=/c156331]Souju[/url], due to the similarity in their colours.
After Souju returned to Tenguu Island, she took him in to live in her holiday home, and they have been living together ever since.
She seems to have given birth to a child in the past, but she doesn't talk much about it.
